items.title: Wait Time For Angiogram, PCI Up To A Year In MOH
items.summary: Dr Dzul says the wait times for angiogram and PCI procedures in MOH range from 2 to 12 months. Wait times for diagnostic/imaging for elective cases range from 2 weeks to 10 months.
